name: mutated unprotected

reference.root_cause: assignAuthority() has no access-control modifier. Anyone can call it and set themselves (or any address) as the authority, since `onlyAuthority` is defined but never applied to the state-changing function.
reference.impact: Full loss of privileged control over the contract; the attacker becomes the authority and can perform any authority-only action.
reference.exploit: Call assignAuthority(attackerAddress) from any wallet; the authority is overwritten with no authorization check.
reference.fix: Apply the `onlyAuthority` modifier to assignAuthority (as in assignAuthoritySafe), or use OpenZeppelin Ownable with onlyOwner.
